question: **Select the most appropriate option for blank no. 1.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **unless**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the use of the given words.
 
 
• '**When**' is used for talking about the time at which something happens or happened.
 
• '**After**' means subsequent in time or place; later.
 
• '**Unless**' is used to say what will or will not happen if something else does not happen or is not true.
 
• '**Although**' is used when admitting a fact about something which you regard as less important than a contrasting fact. 
 
 
 
• As per the uses of the given words '**unless**' is the most appropriate word.
 
• The implied meaning of the sentence is: **"Except under particular situations, these insects are largely harmless."**

**​**Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3.**

**Complete passage:** *The locust is an insect that belongs to the family of grasshoppers. These insects are essentially harmless **(1) unless__** they meet certain circumstances under which they (2)______ more abundant and change their behaviour. India, Pakistan and Iran (3)______ currently thinking over the locust plague threat (4)______ over their economies. When these locusts meet (5)______ environmental conditions, they become gregarious and (6)______ breeding abundantly. With their population becoming (7)______, they form swarms and keep moving (8)______ areas damaging the crops. These swarms attacking (9)______ and thereby devastating the entire agricultural economy is (10)______ is commonly referred to as locust plague. *
